يتراشقا (form VI)
# يَتَرَاشَقَا (yatarāšaqā) /ja.ta.raː.ʃa.qaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاشَقَ (tarāšaqa)
# يُتَرَاشَقَا (yutarāšaqā) /ju.ta.raː.ʃa.qaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاشَقَ (tarāšaqa)
